marks.gloss_en: for R' Meir, who said one carves out to complete, he is liable -- the principle is the reason for the liability
תניא נמי הכי: זרק למעלה מעשרה והלכה ונחה בחור כל שהוא -- רבי מאיר מחייב וחכמים פוטרין
R' Chiyya: one threw above ten and it went and came to rest in a hole of any size -- we have come to the dispute of R' Meir and the Rabbis
תניא נמי הכי: [the inclined alley needs neither post nor beam;] רבי חנינא בן גמליאל אומר: תל המתלקט עשרה מתוך ארבע וזרק ונח על גביו -- חייב
Rav: a mound that rises to ten within four [cubits], and one threw and it came to rest atop it -- liable
והא לא נח? -- [below ten it is as if thrown onto the ground?] but it did not come to rest [on the wall]!
אמר רבי יוחנן: בדבילה שמינה שנינו -- we learned it of a juicy fig-cake (= p_okimta_dvela)
R' Yochanan: it is of a juicy fig-cake that we learned it
the mishna: [one who throws four cubits at a wall] below ten handbreadths -- it is as if he threw onto the ground [and is liable]
תניא נמי הכי: blown in by the wind [before resting], even if blown back out -- exempt (p_ruach_hichnisatu_patur); held by the wind a moment, even if then brought in -- liable
והא לא נח? -- it did not come to rest beyond four cubits; how is he liable?
אמר רבי יוחנן: והוא שנח על גבי משהו -- provided it came to rest on something [beyond four] (= p_vehu_shenach)
R' Yochanan: provided it came to rest on something
the mishna: [one threw] beyond four cubits and it rolled back within four cubits -- liable
Rava: within three [handbreadths], for the Rabbis, requires placement on something
per Abaye: a mat nullifies the partition -- כל שכן a clod nullifies the partition
per R' Yochanan: he is in doubt whether a clod nullifies -- a mat obviously (פשיטא) does not nullify the partition
Abaye: a pit in the public domain ten deep and eight wide, one threw a mat into it -- liable
דתנן: שמן שצף על גבי יין ... רבי יוחנן בן נורי אומר שניהם חיבור זה לזה
Rava: oil on wine is the dispute of R' Yochanan ben Nuri and the Rabbis
תניא נמי הכי: ... רבי שמעון אומר: אם יש במקום שזרק עמוק עשרה ורחב ארבעה -- חייב
Abaye: a pit in the public domain ten deep and four wide, full of water, one threw into it -- liable
Rava: a nut on water -- that is not its resting
